description: An injectable implementation annotated as a binding generates a provider that exposes it under its super type. The provider direction (from implementation to bound type) and the binding kind (single vs multibinding set element) are observable.

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Base

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class)
class Impl : Base

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.example.Impl
provides from=com.example.Impl to=com.example.Base kind=single

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Base

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class, multibinding = true)
class Impl : Base

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.example.Impl
provides from=com.example.Impl to=com.example.Base kind=multi
